planets.name: K2-212 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-212 with a 9.8-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-212 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-212. Its orbit and size follow Duck et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
